items.title: # Brainstorm Gift Ideas
items.content: I need gift ideas for [Recipient's Relationship, e.g., my mom, my friend]. They enjoy [Hobbies/Interests] and their personality is [Personality Traits]. Suggest 5 unique gift ideas under [Budget].

items.title: # Experience Gift Ideas
items.content: Suggest 3 experience-based gift ideas for [Recipient's Relationship]. They live in [City/Region] and are interested in [Activity Types, e.g., cooking, adventure, relaxation]. Focus on memorable

items.title: # Personalized Gift Ideas
items.content: I want to create a personalized gift for [Recipient's Relationship]. They appreciate [Type of personalization, e.g., handmade, sentimental, humorous]. Give me 3 DIY gift ideas I can make or customize.

items.title: # Last Minute Gifts
items.content: I need quick, last-minute gift ideas for [Recipient's Relationship] for [Occasion]. I have [Timeframe, e.g., 2 hours, tomorrow morning] and a budget of [Budget]. Suggest 3 easy-to-acquire gifts.

items.title: # Craft Invitations Easily
items.content: Draft a fun and engaging birthday party invitation for a [Age]th birthday. Include details for [Date], [Time], [Location], [RSVP Contact], and [Theme].

items.title: # Brainstorm Party Themes
items.content: Suggest 5 unique and fun birthday party themes for a [Age]-year-old, along with 3 simple decoration ideas for each theme. Focus on [Child's Interests].

items.title: # Plan Fun Games
items.content: Generate 3 interactive and age-appropriate game ideas for a [Age]-year-old's birthday party with a [Theme]. Include brief instructions for each game.

items.title: # Create Party Menu
items.content: Propose a simple and kid-friendly birthday party menu for [Number] guests, considering [Dietary Restrictions, e.g., nut-free]. Include appetizers, main dishes, and dessert options.

items.title: # Create Custom Story
items.content: Write a short bedtime story for a [age group] child about a [animal/character] who learns about [moral/theme]. Include [specific details/setting].

items.title: # Adventures Of [Character]
items.content: Generate a bedtime story where [child's name/character] goes on an adventure to [place] to find [object]. Make it gentle and reassuring for a [age] year old.

items.title: # Interactive Story Time
items.content: Craft a simple interactive bedtime story for a [age] year old. Present two choices at the end of each short paragraph, leading to different gentle outcomes.

items.title: # Rhyming Sleep Story
items.content: Write a soothing, rhyming bedtime story, approximately [number] paragraphs long, about a [object/concept, e.g., cloud, moon] drifting to sleep. Use simple language for [age group].

items.title: # Best Man Jokes
items.content: Write a witty, heartfelt Best Man speech for [Groom's Name] and [Bride's Name]. Include 2-3 funny anecdotes about [Groom's Name] and a sincere toast. Keep it under 500 words.

items.title: # Maid of Honor
items.content: Draft a warm Maid of Honor speech for [Bride's Name] and [Groom's Name]. Share a sweet memory about [Bride's Name] and offer well wishes. Aim for a heartfelt, engaging tone.

items.title: # Parent's Wedding Toast
items.content: Create a loving wedding speech from the perspective of [Parent/Parents] of [Child's Name]. Share a brief, touching childhood story and welcome [Partner's Name] to the family.

items.title: # Couple's Thank You
items.content: Generate a short thank-you speech for [Couple's Names] to deliver at their wedding reception. Express gratitude to guests, family, and vendors, and include a brief shared sentiment.

items.title: # Plan Any Event
items.content: Create a comprehensive planning checklist for a [Type of Event, e.g., birthday party, conference] for [Number] guests. Include pre-event, during-event, and post-event tasks.

items.title: # Budget Your Event
items.content: Generate a detailed budget checklist for a [Type of Event, e.g., charity gala] with an estimated budget of [Amount]. List all potential expenses and categories.

items.title: # Promote Your Event
items.content: Develop a marketing and promotion checklist for a [Type of Event, e.g., product launch] targeting [Target Audience]. Include digital and traditional strategies.

items.title: # Organize Virtual Events
items.content: Provide a complete checklist for planning and executing a successful [Type of Virtual Event, e.g., webinar, online workshop] for [Number] attendees. Focus on technical and engagement aspects.

items.title: # Design New Survey
items.content: Design 5 survey questions about [Topic] for [Audience]. Ensure they are clear, unbiased, and easy to answer. Include a mix of multiple-choice and open-ended questions.

items.title: # Refine Survey Questions
items.content: Review these survey questions: '[List of questions]'. Identify any potential biases or ambiguities and suggest improvements to make them more neutral and clear for [Audience].

items.title: # Generate Question Types
items.content: Create 3 different types of survey questions (e.g., Likert scale, ranking, open-ended) to gather feedback on [Product/Service]. Target [Audience] and keep questions concise.

items.title: # Craft Survey Intro
items.content: Write a polite and concise introduction for a survey about [Survey Topic] aimed at [Audience]. Explain the survey's purpose and estimated completion time. Also, write a thank you closing statement.

items.title: # Build Buyer Profile
items.content: Create a detailed customer persona for my product/service: [Product/Service]. Include demographics, goals, pain points, and preferred communication channels. Name the persona.

items.title: # Target Content Creator
items.content: Develop a customer persona for [Content Topic] content. Focus on their information needs, preferred content formats, and where they consume content online. Give them a name and brief backstory.

items.title: # Marketing Strategy Persona
items.content: Generate a customer persona for a marketing campaign targeting [Specific Goal, e.g., 'new software users']. Detail their motivations, objections, and what kind of messaging resonates. Assign a name.

items.title: # Innovate Product User
items.content: Outline a customer persona for a new [Product Type] feature. Describe their current challenges, desired outcomes, and what features would be most valuable to them. Include a name and age range.
